items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: We had a very good friend, Leopold de Lima e Silva... Leopold had proposed to us to live there for a very mild rent and of course we had accepted with joy.

ctx.x: So the 29th of June we left Paris with a big load of luggage, our cockatoo named Coco and our Persian cat, Princess. Both animals were scared to death in that car and Coco was repeating non stop "bonjour Coco, ca va Coco?" Princess was mewing. Albert was driving at the speed of 50 miles an hour. We tried to find an hotel room in different places but all the hotels were packed so we had to make the trip non stop except for meals. When we arrived on the Cote d'Azur, Nick was so tired that he was falling asleep on…

We had a very good friend, Leopold de Lima e Silva who was the son of Mistinguett, the famous Music Hall star. Leopold had inherited from his mother a very nice house with a big garden. It was called the Bungalow and was situated at the Cap d'Antibes, between Antibes and Juan-les-Pins, a 10 minute walk to the "Vieux Colombier". The house was separated in two flats, one was empty and Leopold had proposed to us to live there for a very mild rent and of course we had accepted with joy.

The day after our arrival, I had rehearsal with the band and it was terrible. We tried for two hours to rehearse "Caravan" and another number but it was must impossible. Most of those kids couldn't read, and they had no experience at all. It would have taken weeks to try to teach them to play correctly a dozen numbers. I went to see Badel and told him to look for another band. He wanted to put the blame on me because I had accepted to play with them in Paris. I wanted to put the blame on him because we had told…
